excerpt.en: We upgraded sensor-activated dairy cooling into a vision-led decision system — so the control layer can tell a cow from a person before opening the corresponding spray valve.
excerpt.zh: 把传感器触发的牧场喷淋降温升级为视觉决策系统——控制层在开阀之前先分清眼前是牛还是人。

coverAlt.en: AI vision precision spraying system in a commercial dairy barn
coverAlt.zh: 商业牧场牛舍内的 AI 视觉精准喷淋系统

label.zh: 夜间 35–40 lux 识别准确率

heading.en: Keep precision cooling. Remove the ambiguity.
heading.zh: 精准降温要保留，但不能再分不清对象。

quote.en: The system should know whether the object in a spray position is actually a cow — and should not treat people and cattle as the same trigger.
quote.zh: 系统要知道喷淋位置上的到底是不是牛——不能把人和牛当成同一个触发信号。

text.en: A sensing trigger can report activity or occupancy, but it cannot reliably tell a cow from a person.
text.zh: 感应触发只能报告「这里有动静/有东西」，无法可靠区分是牛还是人。

text.en: Light, dust, night operation and target orientation all affect the quality of the decision.
text.zh: 光照、粉尘、夜间作业和目标朝向，都会影响判断质量。

text.en: Without visual evidence, operators have little context for reviewing a trigger, tuning a zone or explaining an event.
text.zh: 没有画面佐证，管理者复核一次触发、调整一个分区或解释一起事件时都没有依据。

heading.en: From “something is there” to “a cow is in this zone.”
heading.zh: 从「这里有东西」变成「这个分区里有一头牛」。

after.en: Classified target inside a defined zone
after.zh: 分区内被分类过的目标

after.en: Independent ROI mapped to each spray position
after.zh: 每个喷淋位置一个独立识别区（ROI）

before.zh: 控制器里的一个状态位

after.en: Image evidence, alarms and event history
after.zh: 画面证据、告警与事件历史

intro.en: The upgrade changes the quality of the input — not the final actuator. Classification now happens before PLC logic issues the valve command.
intro.zh: 这次升级换掉的是输入信号的质量，不是末端执行机构。分类发生在 PLC 下达开阀指令之前。

kicker.zh: 现场实拍 · 夜间识别画面

heading.en: Recognition zones and detected cattle, seen from the control layer.
heading.zh: 控制层看到的识别分区与被识别出的牛只。

intro.en: Independent colored areas define the recognition zones. Cattle are detected by the model before the corresponding zone status enters the PLC decision layer.
intro.zh: 画面上不同颜色的区域就是各自独立的识别区。模型先识别出牛只，对应分区的状态才会进入 PLC 的判断环节。

imageAlt.en: Nighttime camera view with cattle recognition boxes and independent spray zones
imageAlt.zh: 夜间摄像头画面：牛只识别框与各自独立的喷淋分区

banner.zh: 01 · 看见 → 02 · 分类 → 03 · 校验分区 → 04 · 执行

heading.en: A six-stage closed loop from camera to field equipment.
heading.zh: 从摄像头到现场设备的六段闭环。

text.en: Cameras acquire live images from each feeding zone.
text.zh: 摄像头实时采集每个采食区的画面。

imageAlt.en: Field-mounted camera capturing the feeding zone
imageAlt.zh: 现场安装的摄像头拍摄采食区

text.en: The AI model classifies cows and evaluates the defined ROI.
text.zh: AI 模型对牛只分类，并判断预设的识别区。

imageAlt.en: AI model classifying cattle inside the recognition zones
imageAlt.zh: AI 模型在识别区内对牛只分类

text.en: Recognition results are sent to the PLC and the cloud service.
text.zh: 识别结果送往 PLC 与云端服务。

imageAlt.en: Edge AI computing unit transmitting recognition results
imageAlt.zh: 边缘 AI 计算单元上送识别结果

text.en: PLC logic checks zone, timing, mode and operating conditions.
text.zh: PLC 逻辑校验分区、时序、运行模式与工况。

imageAlt.en: PLC control cabinet evaluating zone and timing conditions
imageAlt.zh: PLC 控制柜校验分区与时序条件

text.en: Only the corresponding valve and spray position are activated.
text.zh: 只启动对应的阀门与喷淋位置。

imageAlt.en: Solenoid valve actuating the corresponding spray position
imageAlt.zh: 电磁阀驱动对应的喷淋位置

text.en: Equipment status returns to the AI layer for review and tuning.
text.zh: 设备状态回传 AI 层，用于复核与调优。

imageAlt.en: Equipment status returning to the operations layer

intro.en: A thin data path links visual recognition, control decisions and real equipment status — without a single oversized step dominating the workflow.
intro.zh: 一条很轻的数据链路把视觉识别、控制判断与设备真实状态串起来，没有哪一环重到拖累整体。

heading.en: Four layers designed to operate as one.
heading.zh: 四个层次，按一个系统来设计。

imageAlt.en: Field-mounted camera and protected vision enclosure
imageAlt.zh: 现场安装的摄像头与防护箱体

text.en: Live images cover the feeding line while independent ROIs map visual decisions to individual spray positions.
text.zh: 画面覆盖整条采食线，各自独立的识别区把视觉判断对应到单个喷淋位置。

imageAlt.en: Edge AI computing hardware installed for the upgrade
imageAlt.zh: 本次改造加装的边缘 AI 计算硬件

text.en: The documented system uses an NVIDIA AI computer and switches datasets to match different lighting conditions.
text.zh: 按报告记载，系统采用 NVIDIA AI 计算单元，并按光照条件切换数据集。

imageAlt.en: Dedicated PLC control cabinet and internal components
imageAlt.zh: 专用 PLC 控制柜与柜内元器件

text.en: PLC logic performs secondary processing and commands field equipment; independent sub-control limits fault impact.
text.zh: PLC 做二次处理并驱动现场设备；分控独立，把故障影响限制在局部。

imageAlt.en: Smart spraying control system interface with zone and equipment status
imageAlt.zh: 智能喷淋控制系统界面：分区与设备状态

text.en: Operators can review device connectivity, zone status, alarms and system history from the visual control layer.
text.zh: 管理者在可视化控制层就能查看设备连通性、分区状态、告警与历史记录。

intro.en: The project combines visual acquisition, edge intelligence, deterministic PLC control and operational visibility.
intro.zh: 这个项目把视觉采集、边缘智能、确定性的 PLC 控制与运行可见性组合在一起。

heading.en: Recognition remained above 99% across the recorded light levels.
heading.zh: 记录到的各档光照下，识别率均保持在 99% 以上。

text.en: Reported missed-detection rate 0.01%.
text.zh: 报告记录的漏检率 0.01%。

text.en: Reported missed-detection rate 0.03%.
text.zh: 报告记录的漏检率 0.03%。

text.en: Reported missed-detection rate 0.05%.
text.zh: 报告记录的漏检率 0.05%。

intro.en: The source report documents intermittent image sampling at 8-second intervals between April 5 and April 27, using two online lux sensors installed at the same position and angle.
intro.zh: 据源报告记载：4 月 5 日至 4 月 27 日期间以 8 秒间隔间歇采样，使用两台安装在相同位置与角度的在线照度计。

heading.en: If vision goes offline, cooling does not simply disappear.
heading.zh: 视觉一旦掉线，降温不会跟着停摆。

text.en: Camera connection is checked continuously.
text.zh: 持续检查摄像头连接状态。

text.en: Fault or disconnection is identified.
text.zh: 识别出故障或断连。

text.en: The sub-controller switches to local conventional mode.
text.zh: 分控切到本地常规模式继续运行。

text.en: Alarm and event history notify operators.
text.zh: 告警与事件历史通知管理者。

intro.en: The documented configuration treats camera status as part of the control strategy and preserves a local fallback path.
intro.zh: 报告记载的配置把摄像头状态本身当作控制策略的一部分，并保留了本地降级通道。

proofNote.en: Camera fault response documented for the upgraded configuration, compared with 5 minutes in the preceding version.
proofNote.zh: 报告记载升级后配置的摄像头故障响应时间，上一版为 5 分钟。

heading.en: Built around the actual barn — not a generic model.
heading.zh: 围绕这座牛舍来做，不是套一个通用模型。

text.en: Map cameras, feeding positions, lighting and the existing control network.
text.zh: 梳理摄像头点位、采食位置、光照条件与既有控制网络。

text.en: Create independent visual recognition zones for each spray position.
text.zh: 为每个喷淋位置划出各自独立的视觉识别区。

text.en: Build a dairy-specific dataset around environment, cattle and camera angle.
text.zh: 按本场的环境、牛只与机位角度建专属数据集。

text.en: Connect AI inference, PLC sub-control, valves and cloud operations.
text.zh: 打通 AI 推理、PLC 分控、阀门与云端运维。

text.en: Check day/night recognition, timing, actuation and fault fallback.
text.zh: 验证昼夜识别、时序、执行动作与故障降级。

text.en: Open visual review, parameters, alarms and history to the farm team.
text.zh: 把画面复核、参数、告警与历史记录交给牧场团队。

intro.en: Each stage is executed against this barn — its camera angles, its lighting and its existing control network.
intro.zh: 每一步都是针对这座牛舍做的——它的机位角度、它的光照条件、它现有的控制网络。

heading.en: A smarter decision layer for every spray position.
heading.zh: 给每个喷淋位置配一个更聪明的决策层。

body.en: The upgrade retained position-level control while adding target classification, visual review, day/night adaptation and operational fallback. Recognition performance depends on camera placement, lighting, the barn environment and the quality of the farm-specific training dataset. System configuration and field performance vary by barn, environment and operating requirements.
body.zh: 这次升级保留了原有的位置级控制，另外加上了目标分类、画面复核、昼夜适配与故障降级。识别表现取决于机位、光照、牛舍环境以及本场专属训练数据集的质量。系统配置与现场表现因牛舍、环境与运行要求而异。

statement.en: The project was not about finding a new way to open a valve. It was about making a better decision before the valve opens.
statement.zh: 这个项目要解决的不是「怎么开阀」，而是「开阀之前怎么判断得更准」。
